concepts.learning_objective: Define federalism and distinguish a federal system from a unitary one.

topics.title: What makes India a federal country?
topics.ncert_sections: What makes India a federal country?

concepts.learning_objective: Classify subjects under the Union, State and Concurrent Lists and explain residuary powers.

Analyse how regional parties and coalition governments after 1990 strengthened federal power sharing.
Explain the meaning of decentralisation and the reasons for it.
